_note: Rough per-person estimates in EUR for summer 2027, used when the bot cannot look a price up. Edit freely; the hub settings can override perDay values. Train prices are standard reserved seats (Japan: Shinkansen Nozomi/Hikari, bought as single tickets, usually cheaper than a 7-day JR Pass for Tokyo-Kyoto-Osaka routes).

bags._note: One checked suitcase (23 kg), there and back, when the cheapest fare has none. Researched Nov 2026: the cheapest long-haul fares to Japan on British Airways (Basic), Finnair (Light), Lufthansa/SWISS/Austrian (Economy Light) and KLM/Air France (Light) have NO checked bag; adding one costs about EUR 75-100 per direction (finnair.com extra baggage fees, ba.com Basic fare), so about EUR 180 return was the first estimate; Google Flights' booking page for the BA/JAL multi-city ticket (Nov 2026) shows '1st checked bag: EUR 90-114' for the whole trip, so EUR 110 per suitcase there and back. Google Flights cannot add a checked bag to a multi-city search, so this stays an estimate. Airlines in usuallyIncluded give a suitcase in every economy fare.

confirmedIncluded.note: Owner checked (26 Nov 2026, DUS-HND 27 Jul / HND-DUS 12 Aug, Eurowings/ANA): Austrian, Google ('1st checked bag per passenger free') and Mytrip all show 1x 23 kg checked bag + 8 kg carry-on included, also for 2 adults (Mytrip/Gotogate EUR 971 p.p.).

comfort._note: Owner's choice (Nov 2026): the cheapest real price wins; long flights are only flagged, never charged extra. Flights over maxHours one way are skipped.
